P R O D U C T D A T A S H E E T
current_values.scope_quote: Metacaulk 1000 can be used in interior applications as a general purpose fire rated sealant and smoke seal for construction joints, through penetrations and blank openings on both vertical and horizontal surfaces. Use Metacaulk 1000 to prevent the spread of fire and smoke through joints in fire rated gypsum wallboard partitions, concrete block or concrete walls and/or concrete or corrugated steel deck floor/ceiling assemblies. Metacaulk 1000 is also an excellent fire rated acoustical sealant and can be used in areas under constant vibration or movement to reduce the transfer of noise through assemblies. Metacaulk 1000 can also be used on various penetrations such as EMT, telephone & power cables, insulated pipes, etc. in concrete floors and walls, gypsum walls as well as wood floors.

findings.title: Rated life (L70) not confirmed
findings.detail: LED estimated useful life of at least 50,000 hours at 70 percent lumen maintenance, from IES LM-80 data.
findings.why_it_matters: Without confirmed L70 life, we can’t be sure the lights will last long enough to avoid early replacements on site.

findings.title: Warranty period not confirmed
findings.detail: Warranty Period for LED Luminaires, including LED modules, LED boards, chips, and drivers: Five (5) years from date of Preliminary Acceptance.
findings.why_it_matters: Missing warranty confirmation risks unexpected costs if fixtures fail before the expected five-year period.

findings.title: DLC listing not confirmed
findings.detail: Listed as a qualified DLC product, where applicable.
findings.why_it_matters: No DLC listing means we can’t verify energy efficiency qualifications that may affect rebates or compliance.

findings.title: MacAdam ellipse binning not confirmed
findings.detail: LEDs shall be binned within a maximum 3-step MacAdam Ellipse.
findings.why_it_matters: Unconfirmed color binning could lead to visible color differences between fixtures, affecting lighting quality.

findings.title: Dimming range not confirmed
findings.detail: Continuous dimming from 100 to 5 percent without flicker.
findings.why_it_matters: If dimming performance isn’t verified, lights may flicker or not dim smoothly, causing discomfort or control issues in occupied spaces.
